dedupe_keys.name: synthetic gas electric test case for the travis 150 system

description: Texas A&M University distributes a synthetic coupled electricity and natural-gas network for Austin and Travis County. It combines a 150-bus electric test case with a 47-node gas system containing 23 loads and 46 pipelines. The provider describes it as an input for developing and validating analysis methods for combined electric-gas systems. It is related to the existing Travis transmission-distribution case, but adds a specifically defined gas network. It represents fictitious infrastructure. The case page links a download form requiring an email address. Use is free for commercial and non-commercial purposes under custom terms, with citation encouraged.
